why: The page paints Continue once, at construction, and never again. A live session's own subscriber refreshes it on the arrivals it sees, so the only arrivals this loses are the ones after a session has been disposed (issue #429) -- which, with the session's subscriber now released at disposal, is every arrival the player makes from a route. The page must re-read the run store, not trust the last value a since-dead session painted. 2 of 458 across both scoped files (route-host.test.ts 37 + loop.test.ts 421): the arrival case in each, both of which end a run while the page is away on another route. RE-ANCHORED and re-measured at 3 of 495 (route-host.test.ts 62 + loop.test.ts 433) for issue #324's step S5. The arrival branch now paints the Levels grid beside Continue, so the find narrowed to the Continue call alone and the grid got its own entry; the third failure is loop.test.ts's Continue-availability case, which since the session stopped pushing the signal reads it through this arrival.
